edits.label: Add the distinct actual modules binding weak slot to the same Realm registry
Clear the modules metadata slot before dropping only its native weak entitlement

contract: The actual Registry is shared with the existing fs BindingData and generic BaseEntry FIFO; no second Registry or cleanup registration is created.
Each selected binding type has a distinct native weak-metadata slot, matching Realm's binding_type_int indexed store. Neither slot is a JavaScript root.

The derived modules owner supplies its own real target class/template and BaseEntry. It must retain the Registry through its actual native lifetime, preserve the real target JS edge, and publish the weak slot only after completed construction.
Final Registry retirement requires an empty FIFO. Both stored metadata slots are cleared before their native release, then the Registry and Environment entitlements retire.
Existing FS slot, class IDs, wrapper State, AsyncReset, queue algorithms and public namespace remain unchanged.
limits: This additive storage seam does not implement modules BindingData or certify its construction, cache, publication, ownership controls or whole loader graph.
The binding's existing-slot CHECK and weak winner validation belong to its actual concrete construction path.
